## How this works in your own setup

- Governor runs as a small proxy (Node 18+, no dependencies) between your agents and Anthropic, OpenAI or xAI.

- You change the base URL in your SDK and give each agent its own Governor key with its own caps and tool rules.

- Governor sees the tool calls inside each model reply before your agent does. It blocks the ones a rule denies and holds the ones a rule says need a person.
